description: This file is a PHP script that generates a list view of email templates in the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves email template data from the database, prepares data for display, and renders the output using the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: An extension or class used for Smarty templating within vtiger CRM, instantiated to prepare and display templates.

methods.name: fetch_array
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the result set as an associative array.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns a variable to the Smarty template.
